scope: Review separation of frozen-state query reading and downstream decision use. No training or new inference authorized by this review.
label: INTERNAL DIAGNOSTIC ONLY

source.architecture: original causal no-JEPA large Flat with Local Skip retained
source.pilot_if_later_authorized: seed66 eight retained per-rate checkpoints, not a comparison of single-seed probes with three-seed mean

existing_evidence.probe_boundary: Real Memory beats donor but Local+Memory did not exceed Local. This does not establish a strong residual decision gain and cannot be transferred unchanged to the new canonical baseline.
existing_evidence.state_replay_boundary: Preserving old source Text associations by suppressing subsequent joint writes worsened task CE in paired cohorts; does not identify Query versus Flat.

A.query: original frozen task queries and residual addressing

B.query: same original queries and active-slot reads as A
B.decision: new lightweight readout trained on current Local, active Base/Gap and common availability metadata
B.role: test a specific alternative decoder class; failure does not exclude all decision bottlenecks

C_fixed_decoder_recommended.query: learned normalized correction of original queries, preserving original observed keys, ridge, Gap residualization and active masks
C_fixed_decoder_recommended.decision: copy the fitted B decoder including its normalizer and freeze its exact weights
C_fixed_decoder_recommended.role: positive gains cannot be attributed to further decoder retraining; negative results do not prove Query optimality
C_fixed_decoder_recommended.boundary: The query corrector adds trainable capacity. Use Local/donor controls before attributing gain to retrieval of sample-specific history. This staged fitting is an offline diagnosis, not a prescribed two-stage production method.

C_joint_user_proposal.decision: same decoder architecture/budget as B but jointly trained
C_joint_user_proposal.boundary: C minus B contains Query changes and reader co-adaptation; same decoder capacity alone is not exact causal isolation. Total parameter budget includes the corrector.

D.history: strict-past frozen Local means across all speakers and same speaker, no labels and no current turn
D.decision: lightweight decoder with explicitly matched input projection/total budget
D.role: external history-representation reference, not a same-CHM-state query control
D.boundary: D exceeding B can reflect storage compression, read addressing or representation geometry. It does not isolate Query failure.

code_findings.scan: gcnet_missing_m3/osram.py::_scan reads before the joint block write; writes depend on fixed observed keys/values and not task-query values in the original configuration.
code_findings.addressing: gcnet_missing_m3/osram.py::_address_residual must remain unchanged when testing corrected Gap queries.
code_findings.capture_reuse: WriteCapture and TaskCapture can capture original pre-write state, original current Local, queries and observed keys; keep state detached while performing corrected reads under autograd.
code_findings.gradient_trap: experiments/osram_meld_write_retention_20261014/task_replay.py::original_read is decorated torch.no_grad. It is valid for frozen inference but cannot be reused unchanged for learnable Query training or Query gradients will be cut.

required_controls: Same source model, train/evaluation IDs, masks and read-before-write states in all matched comparisons.
Re-extract from canonical retained weights rather than use the legacy probe cache.
Train probe/query parameters only using training labels; gold historical labels never enter module inputs.
Equal valid utterance coverage, optimization budget and metric conventions; ACC/UA/W-F1 all retained with per-rate results.
Local and donor-history controls distinguish sample-specific Memory use from added Local-dependent capacity.
Verify the source parameter/state hashes are unchanged and corrected-query gradients are finite and can be nonzero on nonempty history.
Inactive Gap and padding remain zero; no-historical-state cases cannot create historical information.
Interpret success as existence of a more useful read/decoder in the tested family; do not infer global optimality from failure.
recommended_next_action: Only if implementation/training is requested: run a seed66 paired B-versus-C_fixed_decoder pilot using the new canonical baseline. Keep A as reference; treat D as a separate history reference rather than proof of Query bottleneck.
